$comment: Source of truth for railway/Tatkal rules. Changes go through code review. Values are immutable per (ruleKey, effectiveFrom): to change a value, close the old entry's effectiveTo and add a new entry. Mark an entry VERIFIED only after checking it against an authoritative, current official source, and fill sourceUrl, lastVerifiedAt and verifiedBy. Never infer regulatory values.
